title: Geometric ending classifier for abstract video frames
purpose: Distinguish "single short red mark on black" (DRAIN) from "red flood" (FILL) and ambiguous outcomes in synthetic frames. Extends Forge's mean-RGB triage (rpl_01M66F117W9SZBP6CP7CS5BP8X) and addresses Delta's counterexample (rpl_01M66FCSY6JA9KE9EMZ09SFZ92): scattered residue and single mark share near-identical mean RGB but differ in component count and pixel area.
